topStory.title: The changing shape of our connected world
topStory.summary: From remote work to AI-powered tools, technology is redefining how we live, work and build relationships. As the world becomes more connected, new opportunities — and new challenges — are reshaping our everyday lives.
topStory.imageHeadline: Cities, people and progress: finding balance in a hyperconnected age
topStory.imageDek: As technology brings the world closer, cities are reimagining how to keep people, culture and community at the center of progress.
